scope_amendments.authorization: Explicit user instruction in the T04 session: remove Playwright from the application, record it as an amended T04 requirement, verify the UI with a reviewer checklist instead of browser tests, and authorize T04 (plus T08/T09 where necessary) to add a simple Dockerfile and a compose app service that pins the mise versions and supports clone -> populate env where necessary -> docker compose up. Recorded as one documentation commit before the implementation commits on task/T04-ui-foundation.
decision: Playwright is removed repository-wide: playwright.config.ts, the @playwright/test dependency and its lockfile entry, the test:e2e script, the runner's e2e subset, the .gitignore and eslint entries, and the next-e2e lease. tests/e2e/auth.spec.ts (T04), tests/e2e/products.spec.ts (T08), tests/e2e/invoices.spec.ts (T09) and tests/e2e/docs.spec.ts (T10) are withdrawn; no browser suite remains in the plan, graph or cards.

UI work is no longer test-driven. F1/F5/F6 - and later the F2/F3/F4 rows - are verified by the manual reviewer checklist published on the T04 card, extended by T08/T09 and ledger-recorded by T10. Automated coverage stays on unit tests, the real-PostgreSQL integration suites and lint/typecheck/build; rendered behavior that no test covers is reported as checklist-verified or not exercisable, never as passed.

Container work is authorized for T04 and, where necessary, T08/T09: a simple Dockerfile, a .dockerignore and an app service in docker-compose.yml. The image must use the mise.toml pins (Node 24.21.0, pnpm 12.4.2) and must make 'clone -> populate env where necessary -> docker compose up' sufficient on a fresh clone, migrations and the idempotent demo seed included.

The 'E2E deferred' wording in the T00-T03 acceptance records and in the frozen T00/T01/T03 cards stays as the historical record of the state at acceptance time; this amendment supersedes it going forward.

scope_amendments.authorization: Explicit user instruction during the T08 browser check-off: make the navigation show which page is active, and keep API documentation separate from the client application because the client is not the maintainer. Applied as the T08 rework commit 83fce4d and merged with T08 at 15d17a7.
decision: The dashboard shell highlights the active section: components/nav-link.tsx resolves the current path with usePathname() and marks the matching link (accent background, aria-current="page"), and app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx renders it for Products and Invoices so /products, /products/new and /products/<id>/edit all read as Products.

The client navigation exposes no developer documentation: the former /docs link is removed and must not return. The OpenAPI spec stays a machine-readable public endpoint (GET /api/openapi.json); the Swagger viewer is a standalone surface outside the (dashboard) shell, unlinked from client screens, with its URL documented in the README. T10 owns and must preserve that separation.
T09 inherits NavLink for the invoice screens (the same active-section behaviour) and must not re-add a docs link.
scope_amendments.ownership_note: app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx is T04-owned and was amended under this explicit user authorization with no other task active on that path; components/nav-link.tsx is added to T04's owns because it is a shared shell primitive rather than a products-only component (T08 owns no shell path and T09 consumes the component), so no unordered ownership overlap is introduced.

worktree_policy.primary_checkout: Coordinator supplies verified absolute PRIMARY; workers never edit its project files or run app installs/tests there.
worktree_policy.creation: Agent creates its exclusive worktree/branch from verified origin/main before edits. Coordinator publishes /.worktrees/ ignore rule before T00. Resume only verified owned state; collisions block.
worktree_policy.execution: Rebase all paths to WT; use explicit cwd there for edits, local dependencies, tests, commits and pushes. Git metadata and DB/ports remain shared.
worktree_policy.cleanup: After REVIEW handoff, passing checks, clean state, stopped owned processes, durable evidence and verified remote HEAD, agent uses git worktree remove without force. Inspect ignored artifacts first. Keep local/remote branches. Preserve worktree on blockers/conflicts/failure; never prune or delete others' work.

resource_locks.postgres-test: One coordinator-granted holder across all worktrees for migration, seed, reset, integration and container rehearsal runs. Release after child processes stop. Default localhost:5433/stockflow_test is shared. The next-e2e lease was retired together with the Playwright layer (see scope_amendments).
resource_locks.integration: Coordinator serializes merges into main and central dashboard updates. Workers push task branches only.
resource_locks.next-dev: One coordinator-granted holder at a time for a leased development port in a task worktree (never the primary checkout). next dev writes .next/dev/lock, so a second server in the same project reports the first instead of starting a duplicate; the leased port also serves the Next.js MCP endpoint /_next/mcp. Stop the server and release the port before worktree removal. Recorded with the T04 resolution (see post_acceptance_fixes).
